:::{#exr-matrix-addition-practice}
#### Adding two $2 \times 2$ matrices

A [matrix sum](#def-matrix-addition) combines two tables of the same shape entry by entry,
such as two months of counts recorded in the same [row](#def-matrix-row)s and [column](#def-matrix-column)s.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -1 \\ 2 & 0 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
\matr{B} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 2 \\ -2 & 5 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Compute $\matr{A} + \matr{B}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Add the entries in the same position,
as in @exm-matrix-addition.

:::

:::
